name: rebodocs
description: A word processor for the browser, compatible with Word (DOCX) files, with its own engine: layout, editing, collaboration, PDF and templates.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p apps/demo && tsc --noEmit -p apps/storage && tsc --noEmit -p apps/realtime && tsc --noEmit -p apps/assistant
scripts.site: npm run build -w @rebodocs/react && npm run dev -w @rebodocs/site
scripts.build:site: npm run build -w @rebodocs/react && npm run build -w @rebodocs/site
scripts.build:react: npm run build -w @rebodocs/react && npm pack -w @rebodocs/react --pack-destination packages/react
